metaTitle: Custom Crew Neck Workwear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom crew neck workwear for your team. Perfect for safety managers and HR. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Crew neck workwear provides a classic, comfortable fit that layers easily under jackets or vests. Unlike V-necks, crew necks offer full coverage at the collarbone, making them a preferred choice for safety-conscious buyers who need a consistent branding area across chest and back. Ideal for uniform programs, these tees accept screen printing or embroidery with minimal distortion. Choose cotton blends for breathability or moisture-wicking fabrics for active job sites.
heroAltText: Custom crew neck workwear with embroidered logo on left chest, safety orange color
